product_metadata.title: Ritz Premium Washable Stain Resistant Kitchen Rug with Latex Backing, Door Mat for Floor, 20"x36", Graphite
features: BUILT TO LAST: Jazz up your living space or apartment essentials with RITZ’s colorfast and stain-resistant Accent Rug. Designed as a kitchen mat, this colorfast and stain-resistant rug is crafted with a sturdy nylon loop and overlock stitched edge finish, ensuring it'll be a durable fixture of your home decor for years
SNEAKY LOW PROFILE: The RITZ Accent Rug isn’t just versatile, it's a ninja, slipping under doors with its ultra-low profile, making it the perfect door mat

THE PERFECT SIZE: Adaptably sized at 20 in. by 36 in. (50.8 cm by 91.44 cm), this area rug is perfect for a variety of uses – whether it's as a kitchen sink rug, a small rug for entryways, or even as floor mats in the kitchen

YOUR CHOICE OF COLORS: Say goodbye to boring rugs – the RITZ Accent Rug comes in a variety of charming colors and coordinates perfectly with its line of kitchen accessories, including mats and runners, to complete your home & kitchen décor

EASY TO CARE FOR: To ensure the longevity and appearance of your RITZ Washable Rug, please avoid vacuuming. Shake out any debris or dirt and machine wash this kitchen rug for easy maintenance and to keep your home decor looking fresh
description: Measuring 20 inches by 36 inches, this rug is perfect for a variety of spaces, from the foyer to the front porch and everything in between. Crafted with a sturdy nylon loop and color-fast dye technology, the RITZ Solid Accent Rug is built to last. Plus, its durable overlock stitched-edge finish ensures that it will remain a fixture of your household decor for years to come. This washable rug is not only fashionable but also practical, with a low profile that allows it to fit easily under doors and a versatile size that makes it an excellent kitchen rug, entryway rug, or decorative accent in bathrooms, laundry rooms, and hallways. It can also function as an anti-fatigue mat for kitchen floors or a hallway runner rug. Available in a variety of charming colors, the RITZ Solid Accent Rug coordinates perfectly with its line of kitchen decor and accessories, including kitchen mats, kitchen rugs, and floor mats. Mix and match to create a look that's uniquely yours and transform your home into a stylish oasis. When it comes time to clean, you'll love how easy the RITZ Solid Accent Rug is to maintain. Simply toss it in the washing machine for hassle-free cleaning, making it a great choice for busy households. With its washable rug feature, it is easy to keep clean and always looking fresh. Upgrade your living room rug, bedroom rug, or any small rug in your apartment or house with this versatile area rug! This area rug can also function as an under sink mat or a door mat to protect your floors from dirt and scratches. It's a perfect addition to your kitchen decor, kitchen sink, or kitchen essentials. The RITZ Solid Accent Rug is also ideal for laundry room decor, as a floor mat, or as a carpet for your home and kitchen. With its durable construction, easy maintenance, and versatile design, this rug is an essential part of any household.
